scope: Production copy and affiliate-attribution correction only

authorization.purpose: Prevent a commercial claim not supported by the provider-account registry

Keep outbound navigation only as an explicit user click. Do not add tracking, referral attribution reporting, background redirects, GPS, contacts, or behavioral profiling.

Do not mark Shopee, Tiki, or any platform as affiliate-active until provider-issued publisher/account identity and deep-link attribution evidence is recorded without secrets. A partner_id string alone is insufficient.
Do not change the 81-offer feed for this correction. Preserve the J370 evidence references and provide a separate stale/removed-offer procedure if a source is no longer current.

verification: Search live served JS and rendered affiliate modal for removed commission/affiliate-active claims
Confirm 30 SKU cards still open their product destinations only on explicit click
Record deployment ID, served hashes, screenshots at 1440, 768, and 390px
completion_definition: Live UI does not claim verified affiliate attribution or commission before provider evidence exists; outbound shopping utility remains available.
